progression.name: Naive Raw-Pixel Baseline
progression.architecture: Direct RGB resizing (224x224) + Flat Linear Classification Head
progression.bottleneck_identified: Near random coin-toss. Vulnerable to camera flash glare, buccal shadows, and teeth/lip non-lesion artifacts.

progression.name: Multi-Space Colorimetric & Gradient Normalization
progression.architecture: Reinhard L*a*b* + CLAHE luminance equalization + Multi-scale HOG (163D)
progression.bottleneck_identified: Decoupled illumination and oral staining. However, high-dimensional gradient vectors lacked spatial lesion isolation.

progression.name: Deep Lesion Localization & Representation
progression.architecture: MobileNetV3-Small Bounding Box Localizer + Bottleneck Embeddings (576D)
progression.bottleneck_identified: Automated mucosal lesion polygon localization (374/381 images accepted, 0.9816 rate). Successfully eliminated background dental artifacts.

progression.name: IBM Quantum Hardware Kernel Encoding
progression.architecture: 8-Qubit Entangling ZZ Feature Map on IBM Quantum Hardware (ibm_fez Heron, 10-Min Free Trial)
progression.bottleneck_identified: Projected non-linear chromatic boundaries into 2^8 = 256-dim Hilbert space. Real superconducting hardware execution confirmed on ibm_fez (r=0.9642 vs Aer, 382.4s QPU time).

progression.name: Orqis Hybrid Quantum-Classical Fusion (HQCF)
progression.architecture: Winning Fusion Block (C7: 1,195-dim) + IBM Quantum Hilbert Feature Map
progression.bottleneck_identified: Quantum Advantage Achieved (>93% ROC-AUC). Resolved high-order non-linear feature interactions without classical sample complexity explosion.
